messages:
Nina (Marketing): Morning team - quick thread to align on the pricing/packaging experiment bundle. Goal: launch updated pricing page + micro-calculator + webinar, and route inbound leads cleanly. Target publish: Fri 9am PT.
Omar (Growth): I'll draft the launch post + key benchmark blurbs. Need percentile latency + token-cost per model from Ben.
Elena (Content): I'll take FAQ edits and webinar description. Tone: straightforward, engineer-friendly, benefits-first.
Ravi (Design): Working on new tier badges and calculator UI. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/pricing-experiment-ui (iterating)
Ben (Data): Uploaded a quick CSV with cost sims. Quick note: median cost varies widely by quantization; I'll summarize top-line figures for the blog.
Lina (BizOps): For routing: webinar registrants -> marketing queue; high-intent form fills (expected > $3k/mo) -> sales tier via webhook. Need final field names.
Nina (Marketing): Can we test tier label language? Proposal A: "Core / Performance / Enterprise"; Proposal B: "Launch / Scale / Secure". Omar can set up a 15% traffic split to B.
Omar (Growth): Yep, will create A/B in the analytics config. Also planning a short benchmark narrative: 3 bullets + CTA to webinar.
Elena (Content): Key FAQ additions: billing granularity, dedicated vs hosted guidance, quantization impact on cost/quality. Will link to technical docs.
Ravi (Design): I'll produce 3 microcopy variants for the tier descriptions (one-liners). Also exporting responsive assets by Thu.
Ben (Data): Confirming I'll provide charts (latency P50/P95) and an example cost calc for 1M tokens/month. CSV path: /drive/pricing-exps/2026-03-costs.csv
Lina (BizOps): I'll configure HubSpot list "pricing-experiment-leads" and a Zap to post big leads to Salesforce. Will share mapping after the form is final.
Nina (Marketing): Event plan: 25-min demo + 20 Qs. Speakers: Nina (marketing), Ben (benchmarks), Ravi (UX). @event-bot schedule provisional slot for Fri 11am PT.
event-bot: Event scheduled "Pricing & Packaging Brief" Fri 11:00 PT  Invites sent.
Omar (Growth): Dev note for calculator embed: need to ensure mobile-friendly fallback and GA events for clicks. I'll add tracking tags.
Elena (Content): Drafting the webinar blurb: "How we measure and optimize inference economics at scale  join our team for a short walkthrough and Q&A". Will post full copy in doc.
Nina (Marketing): Action owners: Omar = launch post + A/B; Elena = FAQ + webinar copy; Ravi = visuals + embed; Ben = numbers + charts; Lina = routing + HubSpot. Confirm?
All: Confirmed.
Elena (Content): Shared doc: https://docs.google.com/pricing-exps-draft  feedback welcome :eyes:
Nina (Marketing): OK, next check-in Wed EOD. Let's aim to freeze content by Thu morning. :rocket:
